name: Armillary
description: Globes drawn in fine line, meridians and parallels on each, with a broader zodiac band crossing at a tilt, the globes leaning together across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { transform: rotate(@rn(-45, 45)deg); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 9%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 95%, #000 95%), radial-gradient(ellipse 33% 50% at 50% 50%, transparent 94%, #000 94% 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 15% 50% at 50% 50%, transparent 88%, #000 88% 100%, transparent 100%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 49%, #000 49% 51%, transparent 51%), linear-gradient(transparent 24%, #000 24% 26%, transparent 26% 49%, #000 49% 51%, transparent 51% 74%, #000 74% 76%, transparent 76%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 9%; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); transform: rotate(-24deg); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 19% at 50% 50%, transparent 80%, #000 80% 100%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
